title: The Killers’ Dave Keuning Says He Survived a Major Stroke: ‘By Some Miracle I Am Fine’
summary: The guitarist says doctors gave him a 40% chance of survival — and that the first thing he checked after surgery was whether he could still play.
body: The Killers guitarist Dave Keuning has revealed he suffered a major stroke two weeks ago and went straight into surgery. Keuning, 50, shared the news in an Instagram post on Thursday (Nov. 26), writing that a blood clot had cut off the blood supply to the right side of his brain. “Two weeks ago, I had a major stroke, and thanks to my wife acting fast, I went straight to the hospital and into surgery,” he wrote. “The first hour after a stroke is critical when it comes to getting to the hospital.” “By the time I arrived at the hospital, I was blind in one eye and had lost function on my left side,” Keuning continued, adding that even then he didn’t realize he was having a stroke. title: You can now change YouTube’s app icon on your phone, but only if you pay for it
summary: Like other apps, YouTube limits custom icons to Premium subscribers.
body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR YouTube is now letting Premium subscribers change its app icon. The current selection includes three options for the icon. YouTube has been testing seven app icons in total, but four are missing from the current rollout. Several prominent apps, including X, Telegram, Reddit, and Instagram, let users swap out the default app icon for something else. Often, this perk is available only to users who pay for the experience. Last month, we learned that YouTube is also working on a similar feature that lets Premium subscribers change the app icon, and it already appears to be rolling out for some folks. User Radu Oncescu on X posted screenshots of the setting that lets users change the default icon to one of the three other options currently available. These include one with a shiny, metal-like finish, somewhat like a silver YouTube Play button, another one featuring what look like brush strokes using red paint, and a third one with a pixel effect and a gradient over the icon.
